svg.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: China's regulatory crackdown on its own technology firms, 2020 to 2023
svg.desc: Timeline, with each firm shown by its logo. November 2020: Ant Group, record share sale halted. April 2021, highlighted: Alibaba fined 2.8 billion dollars. July 2021: DiDi, app pulled from app stores. July 2022: DiDi fined 1.2 billion dollars. July 2023: Ant Group fined nearly 1 billion dollars.
